subject.title: fix(zalouser): clear probe timeout after auth resolves

question: Should this PR keep waiting for non-mocked Zalouser runtime proof, or should a maintainer explicitly override the proof gate for this internal timer cleanup?
rationale: The code path is clear and the patch shape matches sibling cleanup patterns, but the contributor only provided mocked fake-timer proof and cannot satisfy OpenClaw's external-PR real behavior proof gate without additional runtime evidence or maintainer intent.

options.title: Wait for live Zalouser proof
options.body: Keep the PR open and ask for redacted `openclaw channels status --probe` output, runtime logs, or equivalent proof that exercises the resolved-auth path in a real setup.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the unit-level proof for this internal timer cleanup and proceed with normal merge checks.
